groups.sentence: Instructors decide and set appropriate penalty levels, including for first-time and repeat offenders, before the course begins.
Instructors clearly state in the syllabus or course policy the consequences and penalties for unauthorized AI use.
AI-generated submissions cannot receive a passing grade.
Students who misuse AI face a zero or failing grade on the assignment.
Students who misuse AI may face a reduced grade, grade penalty, required revision, or other academic consequences.
Students who misuse AI may fail the course, with penalties escalating for serious or repeated violations.
Students who misuse AI may face disciplinary action, up to suspension, expulsion or dismissal, and misconduct reports.
Instructors may determine the response to AI misuse at their discretion, including a reduced grade, zero, failing grade, or resubmission.
Policy violations may lead to disciplinary action, loss of AI access, termination, or legal liability for all users.
Instructors and administrators apply proportionate responses to AI misuse, taking account of intent, policy clarity and prior offenses.
Instructors apply the stated penalty when AI misuse occurs, such as a zero or a grade penalty.
Employees who violate AI policy may face disciplinary action up to termination, and violations may be noted in evaluations.
